thread:
Asha: Heads-up: uploaded launch blog draft v4 to Drive (https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-v4). Need a quick voice pass + confirmation on webinar vs API CTAs and HubSpot mapping — can we close this today?

Tom: I'll do a pass in 30. Any fresh numbers to call out vs v3?

Lina: New bench blurb: p95 latency improved ~24% vs our baseline, tokens/req cost ~-19%, sustained throughput ~2.1x on Dedicated in our microbench. I can export the chart snippets into the doc.

Priya: CTA flows: we need distinct landing paths: webinar (live demo) -> HS form 'webinar_live_v2', and API trial -> HS form 'api_trial_v2'. Also want separate thank-you emails. @Ken can you confirm final UTM and HS field mappings?

Ken: Proposed UTMs: utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Webinar links should append ?src=blog_webinar_v2. Zapier: webhook -> 'webinar_live_v2' -> add tag "launch_blog_webinar_q2". Will update zaps this afternoon.

Asha: Legal flags: "2.1x" and the phrase "fastest in class". @Lina can legal sign off?

Lina: Numeric "2.1x" ok with qualifier. Replace "fastest in class" with "production-grade latency" to avoid comparative marketing language. Add footnote: "Benchmarks run on Redwood internal harness; results may vary by workload and config."

Tom: Voice edits done: intro tightened, moved benchmarks into a dedicated callout box, softened some superlatives. Left two inline questions around demo screenshots.

Priya: Webinar ops: cap 300 live seats; if overflow we'll gate and push to recording + two office hours sessions. Host: @Tom. Need slides + a short demo script + a run-of-show.

Tom: I got hosting. Plan: 25-min walkthrough, 20-min live Q&A. Will attach slides + 6-step runbook.

Asha: Final approvers for handoff to Ops: voice (Tom), legal (Lina), tracking (Ken), CTAs (Priya). Reply with 'LGTM' or flag edits by 5pm so Ops can spin up HS forms.

Priya: LGTM with tiny copy tweak: exact CTA copy please: 'Register for the live demo' and 'Start your free API trial'.

Ken: LGTM. I'll create HS forms, set thank-you flows, and push UTM params.

Tom: LGTM. I'll resolve the inline questions and drop updated screenshots.

Lina: LGTM from legal. Reminder to include the benchmark footnote text verbatim in the blog and the landing page.

Jules: Quick ask from design: can we get the chart PNGs at 2x resolution and a 1200x628 hero image? Upload to the Drive folder and ping me.

Asha: Great. Maria-ops @Maria-ops can you schedule the registration page publish for 2pm PT tomorrow and reserve webinar vendor room? Also sync with CS on post-webinar follow-up cadence.

Maria-ops: Will do. I'll confirm the HS form URL and room reservation by 5pm today and add CS to the post-webinar playbook.

Asha: Thanks everyone — once Ops confirms URLs, we can wire the CTAs in the post and hand to growth for distribution.
